title: Rapamycin attenuates age-related atrial remodeling and fibrillation by targeting HIF-1alpha-mediated metabolic dysregulation.
authors: Jin, Lingyan; Jiang, Tiannan; Gong, Haoyu; Gong, Lulu; Wang, Yizhen; Chen, Ziwei; Liu, Peng; Qin, Xinghua; Zheng, Qiangsun
journal: Biochimica et biophysica acta. Molecular basis of disease
one_liner_zh: 研究雷帕霉素通过抑制HIF-1alpha改善衰老相关心房重构与房颤，虽含分子对接与动力学模拟，但核心是代谢与疾病表型，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合机制。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Atrial fibrillation (AF) is an age-related disease associated with substantial morbidity and mortality. Although rapamycin stands as a foremost anti-aging therapy with proven efficacy in lifespan extension, a critical gap exists in understanding its impact on aging-induced atrial remodeling and AF susceptibility. OBJECTIVE: This study aims to evaluate the therapeutic potential of rapamycin against aging-related AF and elucidate its underlying mechanisms. METHODS: An aging-induced AF-susceptible mouse model was induced by D-galactose injection, followed by rapamycin diet. Subsequent evaluations included AF susceptibility, atrial electrical/structural remodeling, and mechanistic analyses. RESULTS: Rapamycin significantly reduced aging-induced AF susceptibility. It also ameliorated atrial electrical and structural remodeling. Metabolically, it improved systemic insulin resistance, restored mitochondrial function and morphology, and counteracted aging-induced perturbations in substrate utilization. Mechanistically, rapamycin inhibited hypoxia inducible factor-1alpha (HIF-1alpha) transcriptional activity, a key metabolic target in the aging process. Cellular experiments confirmed that rapamycin directly suppressed CoCl(2)-induced HIF-1alpha expression and nuclear translocation, and pharmacological restoration of HIF-1alpha effectively attenuates the protective effects of rapamycin against D-galactose-induced atrial structural remodeling. Furthermore, molecular docking, dynamics simulations and isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) suggested that rapamycin may also directly interfere with HIF-1alpha dimerization. Importantly, restoration of mTOR activity failed to reverse rapamycin-mediated HIF-1alpha inhibition, suggesting an mTOR-independent regulatory mechanism. CONCLUSION: Our findings demonstrate that rapamycin mitigates aging-induced atrial remodeling and AF susceptibility in mice, primarily through the inhibition of HIF-1alpha and the amelioration of downstream metabolic dysregulation.
abstract_zh: 背景：心房颤动（atrial fibrillation, AF）是一种与年龄相关的疾病，伴随显著的发病率和死亡率。尽管雷帕霉素（rapamycin）作为一种重要的抗衰老疗法，在延长寿命方面已证实有效，但其对衰老诱导的心房重构和AF易感性的影响仍存在关键空白。目的：本研究旨在评估雷帕霉素对抗衰老相关AF的治疗潜力，并阐明其潜在机制。方法：通过D-半乳糖注射诱导衰老相关AF易感小鼠模型，随后给予雷帕霉素饮食。后续评估包括AF易感性、心房电/结构重构及机制分析。结果：雷帕霉素显著降低了衰老诱导的AF易感性，并改善了心房电和结构重构。在代谢方面，它改善了全身胰岛素抵抗，恢复了线粒体功能和形态，并抵消了衰老诱导的底物利用扰动。机制上，雷帕霉素抑制了缺氧诱导因子-1α（hypoxia inducible factor-1alpha, HIF-1alpha）的转录活性，这是衰老过程中的一个关键代谢靶点。细胞实验证实，雷帕霉素直接抑制了CoCl(2)诱导的HIF-1α表达和核转位，而药理学恢复HIF-1α可有效减弱雷帕霉素对D-半乳糖诱导心房结构重构的保护作用。此外，分子对接、动力学模拟和等温滴定量热法（isothermal titration calorimetry, ITC）提示，雷帕霉素也可能直接干扰HIF-1α二聚化。重要的是，恢复mTOR活性未能逆转雷帕霉素介导的HIF-1α抑制，提示存在一种mTOR非依赖性调控机制。结论：我们的研究结果表明，雷帕霉素通过抑制HIF-1α和改善下游代谢失调，减轻了小鼠衰老诱导的心房重构和AF易感性。
